t: All Ways multi-purpose 1 litre sprayer ideal for use in hard-to-reach areas in home and garden. Features a brass nozzle to adjust between fine mist spray or direct water jet, and a pressure release valve. Can be used upside down and sideways whilst maintaining a continuous spray application. Ergonomic handgrip with trigger lock for continuous spray pressure. Suitable for use with water and soluble products, cleaners, insecticides,herbicides and pesticides.
